description: Fresh time-limited validation of the scout-and-follow map: retain every Candidate G setting except a 700-step horizon, then run the same fair three-seed full/no-pheromone delivery comparison.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. Candidate H can move to team review only when full-input PPO beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on seeds 7, 17 and 27. This remains development work; Phase 2B does not start from a single seed.
required_reports: per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and every failed run
